correctness.rationale: Two independent face membership constructions agree on all 262144 subsets. Exactly 8244 facets, 257753 nonempty faces and 18 missing codimension-one faces. A deterministic ordinary matching has one critical vertex and 2074 critical dimension-12 cells. All 2296998 directed Hasse incidences are checked and Kahn ordering processes every face, establishing an acyclic matching. Forman discrete Morse theory proves the integral wedge, not just Betti numbers; the Euler correction 2380-324+18=2074 independently cross-checks.

value.rationale: The eighteen-vertex cubic symmetric Pappus graph is a natural incidence geometry of girth six, exactly below the seven-girth boundary of the closest known five-cut theorem. Its eighteen induced hexagons yield exactly eighteen missing codimension-one faces and correct the expected top sphere count by +18. The complete integral homotopy type of this canonical boundary case gives a useful test for extensions beyond the high-girth regime; neither the object nor the parameter was selected arbitrarily.
